predecessors.name: Colony of New South Wales
predecessors.text: northern New South Wales, 'made the Colony of Queensland'; western boundary 141 E until 1862

successors.name: Commonwealth of Australia
successors.text: Queensland, which 'on 1 January 1901 federated to become a state of the Commonwealth of Australia'

ledger.x: 1859: Queensland is separated from New South Wales.
1862: Queensland's western boundary moves from 141 E to 138 E (13 March 1862): 'Land north of South Australia and east of 138 degrees east was transferred to Queensland.'
1879: the Torres Strait Islands are specifically annexed to Queensland (21 July 1879).

wars.name: Kalkadoon raids and Battle Mountain
wars.outcome: 'Raids conducted by the Kalkadoon held settlers out of Western Queensland for ten years until September 1884 when they attacked a force of settlers and native police at Battle Mountain.'

certainty.note: The western boundary is a meridian in the letters patent (141 E, moved to 138 E on 13 March 1862) and the Territorial evolution page dates each change.
